plan.dataset: MNQ 2026 only; original NQ and sealed 2025 never opened
plan.split_policy: 18:00 America/New_York futures-session boundaries; final Monday partial session disclosed
plan.event_purge: Remove training/development labels whose recorded teacher exit reaches the next boundary minus 60 minutes; also purge every feature row in that last 60 minutes. Oracle exit used for purge only.
plan.label_timing: Imitate oracle direction timestamp aligned to feature candle START, but features are available only at its END and entry is NEXT open: a delayed imitation task, not prediction at teacher entry time.
plan.negative_coverage: Wait labels only between first and last exported teacher entry; completeness of exported trade coverage remains an assumption.

models.logistic: StandardScaler fit on training only; LogisticRegression C=1, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=1000

plan.selection: Highest validation net at $4 all-in modeled round trip among at least 20 trades; ties choose lower turnover then lexical name; no-trade is an eligible zero-net alternative. Freeze all selections before final replay. No final-based tuning or retraining.
plan.momentum: Sign of past 8-bar return normalized by ATR, enter only if absolute value >=1; fixed bracket exit

alma.alignment: UTC multiples of eight minutes; complete contiguous buckets only
alma.signal: ALMA close versus ALMA open crossover, only completed HTF values for causal variant
alma.limitation: Offset, sigma, anchor and exact private Pine semantics are not provided; this is an explicitly specified surrogate, not exact Pine reproduction. A matched lookahead-on surrogate is diagnostic oracle-only.

plan.execution: One MNQ contract, $2/point, 0.25 tick. Next observed CONTIGUOUS minute open only; signals cancelled across missing bars. Stop first if both touched; adverse stop gaps at open, favorable target gaps capped at target. Time exits at completed close. No fabricated fills across closures. Open gap exposure marked unresolved and valued at next observed open, not known before gap. Final position liquidated at last observed close. No same-bar reentry after exit. Entries with zero-volume fill bars cancelled.
plan.teacher_reference: Uploaded teacher P&L is hindsight reference only, with incomplete Yahoo matches and no tradability claim. Oracle timing on same feed can be replayed with non-oracle exits as a separately labeled noncausal benchmark.
plan.promotion: None: short sample, uncertain timestamp/contract roll, no independent provenance. No automatic real trading.
plan.publication: Public: code, tests, aggregate reports and hashes only. Private: raw data, row-level predictions, fills, serialized models and full audit. No Pine source published.

gap_review.status: No independent exchange calendar or contract-specific feed reconciliation; durations alone do not establish whether candles are missing.

teacher_reference.warning: Hindsight trade prices, potentially different feed; NOT executable, NOT a mathematical upper bound, and NOT the same-feed replay above.

same_feed_hindsight_close_reference.warning: Both entry and exit timestamps chosen with future information; observed minute closes, not certified fills. Descriptive oracle-only comparison, not a causal backtest.

limitations: Only roughly two weeks of exported oracle labels; final segment is approximately two sessions including partial Monday.
Timestamp convention, TradingView versus Yahoo feed alignment, and continuous-contract roll mapping lack independent verification.
ALMA offset/sigma/UTC anchor are prespecified assumptions, not verified exact proprietary Pine settings.
Oracle labels are future-informed supervision. Same-row features are available one minute after the assumed teacher timestamp; results are delayed imitation, not foresight.
Negative labels assume the exported teacher trade coverage is complete; missing teacher bars and feature warm-up remove events.
Bar-close drawdown misses intrabar excursions; OHLC cannot certify fills, queue priority or bid/ask spreads. Cost scenarios are assumptions, not broker quotes.
Gap liquidations at the next observed open are explicitly unresolved exposure, not reconstructed tradable paths.
No independent market-source verification or live deployment approval; original NQ 2025 remains unopened.
